subject: Request: Senior Sign-off — Layered Liability & Tail Warranty for NovumTech expansion
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Toby Nash <toby@novumtech.com>, procurement@novumtech.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed SOW & pilot pricing — Redwood + NovumTech

Toby / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is the SOW and the commercial summary for the proposed LLM inference pilot (SOW_NovumTech_v1.pdf, Commercial_Summary_NovumTech.xlsx). Highlights: 6-month pilot, reserved throughput for peak hours, and a one-time implementation discount of 20% off list for the pilot term.

Standard contract notes: our standard liability cap is $250,000 per claim / $500,000 aggregate; standard indemnity language limited to IP and third-party claims; 90-day warranty period on uptime SLAs. Happy to run through these live.

Next steps: let me know if procurement wants a revised SOW or schedule for a final technical review next week.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: SOW_NovumTech_v1.pdf (summary)
Attachment: Commercial_Summary_NovumTech.xlsx (pricing sheet)

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@novumtech.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Toby Nash <toby@novumtech.com>, procurement@novumtech.com
Date: 2029-04-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Proposed SOW & pilot pricing — Redwood + NovumTech

Laura —

Thanks for the materials. Our GC and procurement have reviewed the SOW and attached a redline (Redline_NovumTech_v2.docx) with a few commercial/legal asks that will be gating for NovumTech approval:

- Liability: NovumTech is requesting an aggregate liability cap of $2,000,000 and no per-claim carveouts for IP-based claims (we want parity across claim types).
- Indemnity: broader indemnity language to cover third-party claims arising from data breach/PII incidents, not limited to IP.
- Warranty tail: request for a 12-month warranty tail for any data processing regressions related to the pilot.

We understand this is outside standard terms. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate any of these asks or propose alternative mitigations? We can be flexible on pricing if we get increased contractual certainty.

Sarah Lin
General Counsel, NovumTech
sarah.lin@novumtech.com
Attachment: Redline_NovumTech_v2.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-11T12:35:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: RE: Proposed SOW & pilot pricing — NovumTech redlines (need exec path)

Team — forwarding NovumTech GC redline (attached). High level: they pushed for a $2M aggregate cap, expanded indemnity for data breach, and a 12-month warranty tail. They also signaled willingness to increase spend beyond pilot if we accept.

My suggested commercial counter (to get the deal moving without taking open-ended risk):
- Offer a tiered liability structure: $1,000,000 aggregate cap, but carve out IP-specific claims to a $2,000,000 cap only if NovumTech is paying for an enterprise support add-on.
- Limit indemnity expansion to clearly defined data breach scenarios (confirmed breach with root cause traced to Redwood gross negligence or willful misconduct) — do not accept broad indemnity for third-party claims tied to customer data misuse.
- Approve the 12-month warranty tail but limit remedy to credits or limited remediation obligations (no extended indemnity).
- Offer a blended pilot discount of 25% (vs. our 20% initial) contingent on a 12-month expansion commitment.

Attachments: Redline_NovumTech_v2.docx (from customer)

Ask: Need legal + finance + sales alignment. Marissa/Aditya, do we need an executive sign-off to proceed with the above splits? Ben/Rishi — is the commercial tradeoff (deeper discount in exchange for partial liability uplift + expansion commitment) acceptable?

Thanks,
Laura
Attachment: Redline_NovumTech_v2.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-11T14:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RE: Proposed SOW & pilot pricing — NovumTech redlines (need exec path)

Laura —

I support the suggested counter. Key commercial points: a) 25% pilot discount + 12-month expansion commitment is a sensible incentive, b) tiered liability keeps our downside bounded while giving NovumTech a path to higher recovery for critical IP claims.

If legal confirms the indemnity carve language is tight (gross negligence/data-breach specific), I’m OK escalating for exec sign-off. Recommend we include an explicit expansion milestone in the SOW (MOU-style) so finance can forecast.

Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

On 2029-04-11 12:35, Laura Bennett wrote:
> Team — forwarding NovumTech GC redline (attached). High level: they pushed for a $2M aggregate cap...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-12T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RE: Proposed SOW & pilot pricing — NovumTech redlines (need exec path)

Thanks for the summary, Laura and Ben. I reviewed the redline and drafted an executive memo outlining risk/mitigations (attached: exec_memo_novumtech.pdf). Short read:

- The customer asks create material litigation exposure if accepted broadly. We should NOT accept an unrestricted $2M aggregate cap.
- Counterproposal to present to NovumTech: a) $1,000,000 aggregate cap as baseline; b) an elevated $2,000,000 cap limited strictly to IP infringement claims where NovumTech pays for the enterprise support add-on; c) indemnity for data-breach claims limited to incidents caused by Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct (we will not indemnify NovumTech for their own security lapses or third-party misuses); d) warranty tail of 12 months acceptable but remedies limited to service credits and remediation (explicitly exclude extended indemnity).
- Additional protections: liability carve-ins for third-party connectors, insurance certificate requirement with $5M cyber limits, and an acceptance of dispute resolution via arbitration (reduces litigation risk).

I will escalate this to Rishi for executive sign-off given the cap lift and indemnity stretch. Aditya — if finance confirms the revenue upside covers expected unit economics under 25% discount plus support add-on, Marissa recommends sign-off with the written addendum above.

Marissa Cole
General Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: exec_memo_novumtech.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-12T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RE: Proposed SOW & pilot pricing — NovumTech redlines (exec sign-off)

Marissa / team — thanks for the memo and thoughtful counter. I approve escalation to the proposed commercial compromise with the following binding conditions:

1) We accept the tiered liability construct: $1M baseline aggregate, $2M cap limited to IP claims tied to the enterprise support add-on.
2) Indemnity scope limited to (i) IP infringement attributable to Redwood code/models and (ii) data breaches directly caused by Redwood gross negligence or willful misconduct. No open-ended indemnity.
3) Warranty tail of 12 months allowed, but remedies limited to service credits/remediation and not indemnity expansion.
4) NovumTech must provide proof of $5M cyber insurance and sign the arbitration clause in the JAMS arbitration forum.
5) Finance (Aditya) to confirm final pricing language: 25% pilot discount with an explicit 12-month expansion commitment trigger; revenue recognition and credit terms to be documented in Commercial_Summary_NovumTech.xlsx.

If Aditya confirms the commercial mechanics by EOD, Laura you have permission to present this counter and finalize the SOW subject to the redline conforming to the above. Ben — please document the expansion milestone in the SOW as discussed.

Rishi Malhotra
Chief Executive Officer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
